title: Web Services With Go 网络服务开发

Web Services With Go 网络服务开发

核心概念

Go 凭借高性能的标准库 net/http、内建并发支持和优秀的编译速度，成为构建 Web 服务的首选语言之一。从简单的 REST API 到高并发微服务，Go 都能胜任。

graph TB
    subgraph "Go Web 技术栈"
        HTTP[net/http 标准库]
        MUX[路由<br/>ServeMux / chi / gin]
        MW[中间件<br/>日志/认证/限流]
        HANDLER[Handler 业务逻辑]
        JSON[JSON 编解码]
        DB[数据库访问]
    end
    HTTP --> MUX --> MW --> HANDLER
    HANDLER --> JSON
    HANDLER --> DB
特性 Go net/http Node.js Express Python FastAPI
并发模型 Goroutine（百万级） 事件循环（单线程） ASGI（async）
类型安全 编译期检查 运行时 类型提示
部署 单二进制 需要 Node 运行时 需要 Python 运行时
冷启动 ~10ms ~100ms ~500ms
内存占用 ~10MB ~30MB ~50MB
JSON 性能 快 较快 中等

net/http 标准库

Go 1.22 增强了 ServeMux，原生支持路径参数和方法匹配：

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

type User struct {
	ID        string    `json:"id"`
	Name      string    `json:"name"`
	Email     string    `json:"email"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

type ErrorResponse struct {
	Code    int    `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(data)
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, msg string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, ErrorResponse{Code: status, Message: msg})
}

var users = map[string]User{
	"1": {ID: "1", Name: "Alice", Email: "alice@go.dev", CreatedAt: time.Now()},
	"2": {ID: "2", Name: "Bob", Email: "bob@go.dev", CreatedAt: time.Now()},
}

func handleGetUsers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	list := make([]User, 0, len(users))
	for _, u := range users {
		list = append(list, u)
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list)
}

func handleGetUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := r.PathValue("id")
	user, ok := users[id]
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("用户 %s 不存在", id))
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, user)
}

func handleCreateUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var user User
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&user); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "无效的请求体")
		return
	}
	user.ID = fmt.Sprintf("%d", len(users)+1)
	user.CreatedAt = time.Now()
	users[user.ID] = user
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, user)
}

func main() {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()

	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/users", handleGetUsers)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/users/{id}", handleGetUser)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/users", handleCreateUser)

	mux.HandleFunc("GET /health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
	})

	log.Println("服务启动: http://localhost:8080")
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":8080", mux))
}

路由框架对比

框架 特点 性能 适用场景
net/http (1.22+) 标准库，原生支持方法+路径参数 优秀 简单 API、微服务
chi 轻量、兼容 net/http、中间件丰富 优秀 中大型项目
gin 高性能、功能丰富、社区活跃 极快 REST API、高并发
echo 高性能、简洁 API 极快 REST API
fiber 基于 fasthttp、Express 风格 极快 极高性能场景

chi 路由示例

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
)

func main() {
	r := chi.NewRouter()

	r.Use(middleware.Logger)
	r.Use(middleware.Recoverer)
	r.Use(middleware.RequestID)
	r.Use(middleware.RealIP)
	r.Use(middleware.Timeout(30 * time.Second))

	r.Get("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
	})

	r.Route("/api/v1", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Route("/users", func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Get("/", listUsers)
			r.Post("/", createUser)
			r.Route("/{userID}", func(r chi.Router) {
				r.Get("/", getUser)
				r.Put("/", updateUser)
				r.Delete("/", deleteUser)
			})
		})
	})

	log.Println("chi 服务启动: http://localhost:8080")
	http.ListenAndServe(":8080", r)
}

func listUsers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)  {}
func createUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
func getUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID := chi.URLParam(r, "userID")
	_ = userID
}
func updateUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
func deleteUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}

中间件模式

中间件是 Go Web 开发中的核心模式，遵循装饰器/链式调用设计：

graph LR
    REQ[请求] --> L[日志中间件] --> A[认证中间件] --> R[限流中间件] --> H[Handler]
    H --> R2[限流] --> A2[认证] --> L2[日志] --> RES[响应]
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

type Middleware func(http.Handler) http.Handler

func Chain(h http.Handler, middlewares ...Middleware) http.Handler {
	for i := len(middlewares) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		h = middlewares[i](h)
	}
	return h
}

func LoggingMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		start := time.Now()
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		log.Printf("%s %s %v", r.Method, r.URL.Path, time.Since(start))
	})
}

func RecoveryMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		defer func() {
			if err := recover(); err != nil {
				log.Printf("panic recovered: %v", err)
				http.Error(w, "Internal Server Error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			}
		}()
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func CORSMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization")

		if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			return
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func AuthMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		token := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
		if token == "" {
			http.Error(w, "未授权", http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func main() {
	handler := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "Hello, World!")
	})

	wrapped := Chain(handler,
		RecoveryMiddleware,
		LoggingMiddleware,
		CORSMiddleware,
	)

	http.Handle("/", wrapped)
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil))
}

限流中间件

package main

import (
	"net/http"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type RateLimiter struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	tokens   float64
	maxTokens float64
	refillRate float64
	lastTime time.Time
}

func NewRateLimiter(rps float64) *RateLimiter {
	return &RateLimiter{
		tokens:    rps,
		maxTokens: rps,
		refillRate: rps,
		lastTime:  time.Now(),
	}
}

func (rl *RateLimiter) Allow() bool {
	rl.mu.Lock()
	defer rl.mu.Unlock()

	now := time.Now()
	elapsed := now.Sub(rl.lastTime).Seconds()
	rl.tokens += elapsed * rl.refillRate
	if rl.tokens > rl.maxTokens {
		rl.tokens = rl.maxTokens
	}
	rl.lastTime = now

	if rl.tokens >= 1 {
		rl.tokens--
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func RateLimitMiddleware(limiter *RateLimiter) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if !limiter.Allow() {
				http.Error(w, "请求过于频繁", http.StatusTooManyRequests)
				return
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

优雅关闭

生产环境的 HTTP 服务必须支持优雅关闭——停止接受新连接，等待现有请求处理完成：

sequenceDiagram
    participant OS as 操作系统
    participant Server as HTTP Server
    participant Handler as 请求处理

    OS->>Server: SIGINT / SIGTERM
    Server->>Server: 停止接受新连接
    Server->>Handler: 等待进行中的请求完成
    Handler-->>Server: 请求处理完成
    Server->>Server: 关闭连接、释放资源
    Server-->>OS: 退出
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "Hello!")
	})

	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:         ":8080",
		Handler:      mux,
		ReadTimeout:  15 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout: 15 * time.Second,
		IdleTimeout:  60 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		log.Printf("服务启动: http://localhost%s", server.Addr)
		if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			log.Fatalf("HTTP 服务错误: %v", err)
		}
	}()

	quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	sig := <-quit
	log.Printf("收到信号 %v，开始优雅关闭...", sig)

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("优雅关闭失败: %v", err)
	}

	log.Println("服务已安全退出")
}
Server 参数 推荐值 说明
ReadTimeout 10-30s 读取请求体超时
WriteTimeout 10-30s 写入响应超时
IdleTimeout 60-120s Keep-Alive 空闲超时
MaxHeaderBytes 1MB 请求头最大字节数
Shutdown 超时 30s 优雅关闭最长等待时间

结构化日志

现代 Go 应用推荐使用结构化日志（JSON 格式），便于日志聚合系统（ELK、Loki）处理：

package main

import (
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"time"
)

func setupLogger(env string) *slog.Logger {
	var handler slog.Handler
	opts := &slog.HandlerOptions{
		Level: slog.LevelInfo,
	}

	switch env {
	case "production":
		handler = slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, opts)
	default:
		handler = slog.NewTextHandler(os.Stdout, opts)
	}

	return slog.New(handler)
}

func loggingMiddleware(logger *slog.Logger) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			start := time.Now()

			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)

			logger.Info("HTTP 请求",
				slog.String("method", r.Method),
				slog.String("path", r.URL.Path),
				slog.String("remote_addr", r.RemoteAddr),
				slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
				slog.Duration("latency", time.Since(start)),
			)
		})
	}
}

func main() {
	logger := setupLogger("production")
	slog.SetDefault(logger)

	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/data", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		logger.Info("处理数据请求",
			slog.String("request_id", r.Header.Get("X-Request-ID")),
		)
		w.Write([]byte(`{"data": "hello"}`))
	})

	handler := loggingMiddleware(logger)(mux)

	logger.Info("服务启动", slog.String("addr", ":8080"))
	http.ListenAndServe(":8080", handler)
}
日志库 特点 适用场景
log/slog（标准库） Go 1.21+，结构化日志 新项目首选
zap 极高性能，零分配 高吞吐场景
zerolog 零分配，JSON 优先 性能敏感场景
logrus 功能丰富，社区成熟 遗留项目

配置管理

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"time"
)

type Config struct {
	Server   ServerConfig   `json:"server"`
	Database DatabaseConfig `json:"database"`
}

type ServerConfig struct {
	Host         string        `json:"host"`
	Port         int           `json:"port"`
	ReadTimeout  time.Duration `json:"read_timeout"`
	WriteTimeout time.Duration `json:"write_timeout"`
}

type DatabaseConfig struct {
	Host     string `json:"host"`
	Port     int    `json:"port"`
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	User     string `json:"user"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
	MaxConns int    `json:"max_conns"`
}

func LoadConfig() (*Config, error) {
	cfg := &Config{
		Server: ServerConfig{
			Host:         "0.0.0.0",
			Port:         8080,
			ReadTimeout:  15 * time.Second,
			WriteTimeout: 15 * time.Second,
		},
		Database: DatabaseConfig{
			Host:     "localhost",
			Port:     5432,
			MaxConns: 25,
		},
	}

	if host := os.Getenv("SERVER_HOST"); host != "" {
		cfg.Server.Host = host
	}
	if port := os.Getenv("SERVER_PORT"); port != "" {
		if p, err := strconv.Atoi(port); err == nil {
			cfg.Server.Port = p
		}
	}
	if dbHost := os.Getenv("DB_HOST"); dbHost != "" {
		cfg.Database.Host = dbHost
	}
	if dbPassword := os.Getenv("DB_PASSWORD"); dbPassword != "" {
		cfg.Database.Password = dbPassword
	}

	return cfg, nil
}

func (c *Config) Addr() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", c.Server.Host, c.Server.Port)
}

func main() {
	cfg, err := LoadConfig()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("配置加载失败:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
	fmt.Println(string(data))
}
配置方式 优先级 适用场景
环境变量 最高 容器化部署、敏感信息
配置文件 中 复杂配置、开发环境
命令行参数 中 CLI 工具、覆盖配置
默认值 最低 合理的默认行为

生产部署清单

flowchart TD
    BUILD[构建] --> BINARY["CGO_ENABLED=0<br/>静态编译"]
    BINARY --> DOCKER[Docker 镜像<br/>scratch / distroless]
    DOCKER --> HEALTH[健康检查<br/>/health 端点]
    HEALTH --> GRACE[优雅关闭<br/>SIGTERM 处理]
    GRACE --> LOG[结构化日志<br/>JSON 格式]
    LOG --> METRICS[指标暴露<br/>Prometheus]
    METRICS --> DEPLOY[部署]
CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o app ./cmd/server
FROM golang:1.22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /app/server ./cmd/server

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12
COPY --from=builder /app/server /server
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]

常见陷阱

  • 忽略 Server 超时设置：零值超时意味着永远等待，慢客户端会持续占用连接，应显式配置 Read/Write/Idle 超时。
  • Handler 中不做 panic 恢复：单个请求的 panic 会终止整个进程，需要 Recovery 中间件兜底。
  • 中间件顺序颠倒：认证放在日志之前、限流放在认证之后等顺序错误，会导致记录不到被拒请求或限流形同虚设。
  • Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * 用于带凭据的接口：通配来源无法与凭证请求共存，会被浏览器拒绝且存在安全风险。
  • 缺少优雅关闭：直接 os.Exit 或未监听 SIGTERM，部署滚动更新时会切断进行中的请求。

小结

Go 是构建 Web 服务的理想选择，标准库已足够强大，框架生态成熟且高性能。

知识点 核心要点
net/http Go 1.22+ 原生支持方法+路径参数
路由框架 chi 轻量兼容、gin 高性能
中间件 链式装饰器模式，日志/认证/限流/CORS
优雅关闭 signal.Notify + Server.Shutdown
结构化日志 log/slog（标准库）或 zap
配置管理 环境变量 > 配置文件 > 默认值
生产部署 静态编译 + distroless 镜像
